<!-- pr-reviewer: ee0405765843355dff71e1add7ecdceffd8166e9 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge, after #2112 (stacked parent, still open). No blocking findings. This is the independent review of the head at ee0405765; the author's marker on this head is not an independent review of work under the safety floor.

**Head and merge check**

- Head ee0405765843355dff71e1add7ecdceffd8166e9. Its own change is this last commit; the two commits under it belong to #2112. I reviewed this commit only.
- Trial merge with main (98f093fba): clean, no conflicts. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.

**What I ran (locally, Windows debug build, on the trial merge)**

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib -- adaptive`: 76 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test rest_adaptive`: 9 passed, 0 failed (83.8 s).
- `--test rest2d`: 10 passed. `--test adaptive_hsm`: 2 passed, 5 ignored. `--test optimal_load`: 4 passed. `--test machining2d`: 66 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The author's record ran macOS only. This run adds Windows. The neck load pin passed here: the worst measured load stays under 15.377% of D.

**Law checks (AGENTS.md)**

- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` outside tests in the changed files. Index math in `cut_count` clamps and guards non-finite input. Slice `pts[run_at.min(pts.len())..]` cannot panic; an empty `done` returns `None` in `retrace` through the `done.last()` check.
- The budget refuses by name, with the fix ("choose Waterline or Offset rings"). The refusal test asserts both limit texts.
- A retrace is offered to the same three checks as every lead: centre area, crossing law, load walk. It is a feed at cut depth, never a plunge. Cells change only where a run starts, never what `runs()` cuts; coverage still refuses by name.
- Provenance lines present in `budget.rs` and the touched module docs. Files are under 400 lines (peel.rs 359, leads.rs 339, budget.rs 82).
- Body is complete: `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #2109`, conventional subject. Decision record `docs/decisions/2109-rest-adaptive-air.md` follows the format.
- No process file, dependency, `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, script, `.github`, golden or snapshot change. No new command, so no MCP item owed; Rest Adaptive is not wired into the Pocket operation until #2033.
- Body claims check out: the pins it names exist and pass, and the mutation claims match the code paths.

**Requested before merge**

None.

**Notes (not blocking)**

1. The neck load margin is 0.0013% of D against the planner's own cap. It held on macOS and on Windows here, but a stated headroom in that one assertion would remove the platform risk. The author's record names the same point.
2. The neck test ran just over 60 s in debug here (84 s for the whole binary). The 60 s rule may want a smaller fixture or a heavy-lane note later.
3. Merge order: #2112 first, as the body says. This PR's diff against main also shows the parent's commits until the parent merges.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
